$comment: Global role -> model routing. Format is OpenCode 'provider/model'; the Splice backend strips the 'amazon-bedrock/' prefix (bedrockModelId() in packages/backend/src/models.ts). Env overrides per role: MODEL_<ROLE_UPPER> (e.g. MODEL_SPEC_WRITER). OPENCODE_MODEL remains the legacy override for the default role. Splice roles (spec_writer, engine_writer, ui_synthesizer, refusal_fallback) go through llm.ts: Claude models use the Anthropic Messages API on Bedrock with structured outputs; a non-Claude model is allowed only if its options entry has splice_compatible: true (llm.ts calls it through the Bedrock Converse API with a forced tool call for JSON). refusal_fallback must be Claude. Verify each ID is enabled in the Bedrock console for your AWS_REGION.

role_notes.decomp_worker: Python OpenCode/Ghidra worker (launch.py). Any OpenCode-supported model.
role_notes.spec_writer: Splice Step 2: requirements + acceptance tests + oracle adapter. Claude only.
role_notes.engine_writer: Splice Step 3a implementor agent: writes the engine from the spec. Qwen3 Coder 480B via Bedrock Converse (verified on this account in us-east-2, 2026-10-24); Claude Opus 5.5 when the account has access.
role_notes.ui_synthesizer: Splice Step 3b: UI synthesis + refine/auto-fix. Claude only.
role_notes.refusal_fallback: Retried once when a Splice role's model returns stop_reason 'refusal' (Bedrock has no server-side fallbacks). Claude only.

options.label: Qwen3 Coder 480B (A35B)
options.note: Coding model. Splice's implementor agent (engine_writer) through llm.ts's Bedrock Converse path; also usable by OpenCode roles. Verified in us-east-2 with the bare ID (the us. inference profile is rejected).
